description: Decode and encode of cash tokens (any HRP): TLV 0-3, the provenance pair 5/6 and its scheme (TLV 8; without it a token has no valid provenance), the hub group (TLV 7), encoder refusals, ascending entry order on encode, and bech32 framing (an all-uppercase token decodes as its lowercase form, a mixed-case one is refused). Signed connection strings are in connection.json, nconnection1 in nconnection.json.
source: nipcash/token.go, internal/credcodec; nipcash/token_codec_test.go (K-TOK-1), decode_tlv_rules_test.go, token_test.go, hub_group_test.go, encode_relay_test.go, kat_test.go
